method: Author-written questions and evidence annotations fixed before the first full-corpus ranking run. Development set, not an independent or held-out benchmark. Evidence phrases can occur in multiple documents; all matching passages are accepted.

questions.question: Why does the small text encoder use four-byte weights on this GPU instead of half precision?
questions.answer_key: FP32 is used because Xavier has no native BF16 and this model is unsafe in FP16.

questions.question: My passage is exactly 128 content tokens. Will the embedding endpoint accept it unchanged?
questions.answer_key: No. The 128-token budget includes BOS/EOS and any task/title prefix; overlong inputs are rejected, not truncated.

questions.question: Can I store shorter vectors, and what must happen after keeping only the leading coordinates?
questions.answer_key: Use 128, 256, 512 or 768 dimensions; renormalize after truncation.

questions.question: Why does the embedding worker manually insert tokens around the input string?
evidence: MLC's tokenizer encodes content without Hugging Face post-processing
questions.answer_key: MLC tokenization omits the Hugging Face post-processing, so the worker explicitly adds the checkpoint's BOS and EOS.

questions.question: Can a tiny vector lookup interrupt a language model that is already producing an answer?
evidence: The existing queue still serializes whole requests
questions.answer_key: No. The shared FIFO serializes whole requests; token/block preemption and priorities are not implemented.

questions.question: If a client abandons its stream while GPU work is still running, when may another request start?
evidence: cancellation drains GPU work before releasing
cancellation drains that worker before releasing
questions.answer_key: The active worker must drain before the shared queue is released.

questions.question: When the assistant asks to read a file or execute a shell command, which machine actually does it?
evidence: Pi executes tools on the client
tool execution happens in the client
questions.answer_key: The Pi client executes tools locally; the inference service only generates and translates tool calls.

questions.question: Node does not recognize the certificate issuer even though the root is installed in the OS. What setting enables that trust?
questions.answer_key: Set NODE_USE_SYSTEM_CA=1 before starting Node/Pi.

questions.question: Why did Pi let the 4K chat model return only a single token, and how was the request fixed?
questions.answer_key: Pi's fixed 4096-token safety margin clamped output to one token; explicitly set samplingParams.max_tokens to 512 while retaining server budget checks.

questions.question: Which extension withheld even tiny file-read results and sent the agent into repeated reads?
questions.answer_key: pi-clm's guard withheld the result; its extensions list is disabled while native Pi compaction remains active.

questions.question: Should we increase the speculative proposal count to three as the general default?
evidence: Keep **two draft tokens** as the general
questions.answer_key: No. Two is the general setting; three only slightly helped short chat and regressed the longer cases.

questions.question: Can Google's original 12B assistant simply replace the diffusion drafter in our current speculative engine?
evidence: it cannot replace the diffusion drafter
requires a separate Gemma4 MTP execution path
questions.answer_key: No. The native Unified assistant needs its own MTP path and cannot directly replace DFlash's diffusion drafter.

questions.question: Which instruction and activation format accelerate the small verification matrix operations on Volta?
questions.answer_key: The native kernel quantizes activations to signed Q8 and uses DP4A with the q4f16_1 weights.

questions.question: Which prefill option is simpler, and what extra arithmetic does the faster alternative introduce?
questions.answer_key: width is simpler; hybrid additionally uses FP16 attention probabilities with Volta WMMA for current-chunk attention.

questions.question: What persistent fan profile was selected for maximum-performance operation?
questions.answer_key: cool replaced quiet; pid and open_loop were retained.

questions.question: Do the larger 16K and 4K context builds require converting all weights again or rebuilding the C++ runtime?
evidence: No weight reconversion or C++ runtime rebuild is required
questions.answer_key: No. Existing converted artifacts are reused; new context configurations and model libraries are built.

questions.question: Which exact replacement power-adapter product number permanently eliminated the board shutdowns?
questions.answer_key: Not found in supplied sources. No permanent power fix or replacement product number is documented.

questions.question: What is the measured embedding throughput at 32 simultaneous clients?
questions.answer_key: Not found in supplied sources. No 32-client throughput measurement is documented.

questions.question: What retrieval accuracy did we obtain on our private customer-ticket archive?
questions.answer_key: Not found in supplied sources. There is no private ticket-archive evaluation.

questions.question: Which vector database and version are used by our production search deployment?
questions.answer_key: Not found in supplied sources. The production vector database and version are not documented.
